SLB Vejle Gastroenterologisk Amb. is a gastroenterology ambulatory clinic and healthcare facility based in Vejle, Denmark. It is featured in the DANIBD 2025 report, which evaluates the quality of care and quality development efforts for patients with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) across the Danish healthcare system [^src1]. 

The facility is particularly significant for its performance on Indikator 2, a quality metric that measures patient education [^src1]. SLB Vejle Gastroenterologisk Amb. is recognized as a positive outlier in this area, reporting a fulfillment rate of 27% in both the 2022/23 and 2023/24 periods [^src1]. This performance is notably higher than the national average fulfillment rate of 13% for the same indicator [^src1]. In a report that extensively discusses systemic challenges, such as diagnostic coding errors and the need for clinically relevant investigations, SLB Vejle's consistent overperformance in patient education highlights a localized success within the broader national quality improvement framework [^src1].
